literal_meaning: চুঁ শব্দ (কোনো সামান্য শব্দ বা আওয়াজ)
figurative_meaning_en: The slightest word of objection or protest
example_sentences_in_bangla: সিদ্ধান্তের বিরুদ্ধে চুঁশব্দ পর্যন্ত উঠল না।
example_sentences_in_english: No one made a peep in the meeting.
There wasn't even a murmur of dissent against the decision.
note: Refers to complete silence in agreement or submission, common in Bengali expressive language.
